title: Pure Dogmatika
summary: Pure Dogmatika Ritual and Extra Deck hate build with generic staples. Dogmatika monsters Special Summon themselves from the hand once an Extra Deck monster is on the field and rip cards directly out of both players' Extra Decks.

summary.title: Starters
points: Dogmatika Ecclesia, the Virtuous Special Summons itself from the hand while an Extra Deck monster is on the field, cannot be destroyed by battle with Extra Deck monsters, and searches any Dogmatika card on Normal or Special Summon.

Dogmatikamatrix searches a Dogmatika Ritual Monster or Ritual Spell on activation (plus a second Dogmatika card if the opponent controls a monster), and once per turn sends a monster from either player's Extra Deck to the GY.

Dogmatika Lawbringer Special Summons itself from the hand while an Extra Deck monster is on the field, makes each player send 1 monster from their Extra Deck to the GY, and recovers a Dogmatika card when sent to the GY.

summary.title: Opening: Ecclesia + Dogmatikamatrix
steps: Normal or Special Summon Dogmatika Ecclesia, the Virtuous to search Dogmatikamatrix, then activate Dogmatikamatrix to search Dogmatika Alba Zoa or White Knight of Dogmatika alongside Dogmatikalamity.
Activate Dogmatikalamity to Ritual Summon Dogmatika Alba Zoa by sending a Level 12 monster from your Extra Deck to the GY, or use Dogmatikamacabre to Ritual Summon from the hand or GY.

Special Summon Dogmatika Maximus by banishing an Extra Deck monster from your GY so both players send 2 cards from their Extra Deck to the GY, then summon Dogmatika Fleurdelis, the Thunderbolt to Set a Dogmatika Trap that can be activated this turn.

summary.title: Extra Deck Destruction & Ritual Bosses
points: Dogmatika Alba Zoa (4000 ATK Level 12 Ritual) makes all Dogmatika monsters you control unaffected by the activated effects of the opponent's Fusion, Synchro, Xyz, and Link Monsters, and forces the opponent to either return all Extra Deck monsters they control or send 1 card from their hand or Extra Deck to the GY for every 2 cards in your Extra Deck.

White Knight of Dogmatika sends a monster from your Extra Deck and 1 from the opponent's Extra Deck whenever the opponent activates a card or effect, while White Relic of Dogmatika boosts a Dogmatika and shreds the opponent's Extra Deck on Ritual Summon.
Alba System Dogmatikalamity, summoned via Fallen of Albaz and 6 monsters in your GY, attacks all opposing monsters and sends both players' remaining Extra Decks to the GY.

summary.title: Disruption, Locks & Left out
points: Ecclesia, Maximus, Lawbringer, Dogmatikamatrix, Dogmatikalamity, and Dogmatika Punishment lock you out of Special Summoning from the Extra Deck for the rest of the turn (or until the end of your next turn for Punishment).

Dogmatika Fleurdelis, the Knighted Special Summons itself during either Main Phase and negates a face-up monster while you control another Dogmatika, and Dogmatika Fleurdelis, the Thunderbolt Sets Dogmatika Punishment, Quadogmatika Beast, or Dogmatika Encounter live on the same turn.
Quadogmatika Beast sends an Extra Deck monster or Main Deck Dogmatika to the GY to revive a Dogmatika, while Dogmatika Ashiyan and Adin extend and recycle your engine.
Left out: The page's Mitsurugi Ritual alliance is omitted so this list stays pure Dogmatika.

allow.Alba System Dogmatikalamity: Fallen of Albaz Fusion that sends both Extra Decks to the GY; a Dogmatika-named boss.

main: Dogmatika Lawbringer
Newest support. Summons itself next to an Extra Deck monster and makes each player dump one; sent to the GY, returns a Dogmatika card.
Dogmatika Ecclesia, the Virtuous
Summons itself next to an Extra Deck monster; summoned, searches any Dogmatika card.
Dogmatika Fleurdelis, the Thunderbolt
2025 support. Summons itself on either Main Phase and Sets a Dogmatika Trap, live this turn.
Dogmatika Maximus
Banishes an Extra Deck monster to summon itself; each player sends two from their Extra Deck.
Dogmatika Fleurdelis, the Knighted
Summons itself on either Main Phase and negates a monster.
Dogmatika Adin, the Enlightened
Summons itself next to an Extra Deck monster; destroyed, pulls a Dogmatika from the Deck.
Dogmatika Theo, the Iron Punch
Summons itself next to an Extra Deck monster and shrinks one.
Dogmatika Ashiyan
Summons itself when an Extra Deck monster hits the GY and returns a Dogmatika card.
Fallen of Albaz
Counts as Dogmatika: Fusion Summons using your opponent's monsters.
White Knight of Dogmatika
Level 8 Ritual: dumps from both Extra Decks whenever they activate.
White Relic of Dogmatika
Level 4 Ritual: protects your big Dogmatikas and dumps their Extra Deck monsters.
Dogmatika Alba Zoa
Level 12 Ritual: unaffected by their Extra Deck monsters and makes them shed cards.
Dogmatikamatrix
Searches a Dogmatika Ritual card, then another Dogmatika card.
Dogmatikalamity
Ritual Spell that can pay with an Extra Deck monster of the same Level.
Dogmatikamacabre
Ritual Spell from the hand or GY, banishing Fusions or Synchros as Levels.
Dogmatika Nation
Field Spell: shields Dogmatikas from Extra Deck monster effects.
Dogmatika Punishment
Dumps a bigger Extra Deck monster to destroy one of theirs.
Quadogmatika Beast
2025 support. Dumps a big monster from the Extra Deck or a Dogmatika from the Deck to revive one.
Dogmatika Encounter
Summons a Dogmatika from the hand, or returns one from the GY.
extra: Fallen of Albaz + six monsters in the GY: attacks every monster and can empty both Extra Decks.
